name: models.yml accepts environment references and auth none but rejects plaintext keys

valid:
providers:
  alpha:
    api: openai-responses
    baseUrl: https://alpha.example.test/v1
    apiKey: ${ALPHA_API_KEY}
providers:
  beta:
    api: anthropic-messages
    baseUrl: https://beta.example.test
    auth: none
invalid:
providers:
  alpha:
    apiKey: sk-live-private
providers:
  alpha:
    models:
      - id: one
      - id: one
modelRoles:
  default: alpha/one
